metadata.dataset: epithelial_buckling_crypt_villus / Pass 3 tubular ring-FEM & Shh/BMP cluster reference
metadata.purpose: Reference values and model constants for the Pass 3 remediation: reduced 3D tubular neo-Hookean mesenchymal foundation (axisymmetric ring FEM verified against the Lame thick-cylinder solution) and spatially localized Shh/BMP mesenchymal cluster signaling at zigzag elbows / villus tips.
sources: Shyer AE et al. (2013) Science 342:212-218, doi:10.1126/science.1238842 (Fig. 1 stage geometry: lumen radius, mesenchyme depth, wavelengths, ridge counts)
Shyer AE, Huycke TR, Lee C, Mahadevan L, Tabin CJ (2015) Cell 161:569-580, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2015.03.041 (Shh concentrates beneath curved epithelium at fold apices; Shh -> Bmp in clusters)
Walton KD et al. (2012) PNAS 109:15817-15822, doi:10.1073/pnas.1205669109 (one Hh-responsive mesenchymal cluster per emerging villus)
Walton KD et al. (2016) Development 143:427-436, doi:10.1242/dev.130112 (Bmp signalling in clusters controls villus patterning)
Timoshenko SP, Goodier JN (1970) Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., sec. 28 (Lame thick-walled cylinder)
Donnell LH (1933) NACA Report 479 (shallow cylindrical shell theory)
metadata.doi_verification: DOIs for Shyer 2015 and Walton 2016 recorded offline (not re-verified online during the isolated run).

tubular_foundation_model.geometry: Mesenchymal annulus R_in = R_lumen, R_out = R_lumen + H_s; epithelium on the inner face, differentiated smooth-muscle sheath as rigid outer wall (u(R_out) = 0).
tubular_foundation_model.discretisation: 48 linear axisymmetric plane-strain ring elements, 2-point Gauss quadrature, strains eps_rr = du/dr, eps_tt = u/r.
tubular_foundation_model.constitutive: Plane-strain Lame moduli from the neo-Hookean tangent modulus E_tan(eps) = E_s (2 lambda + lambda^-2) / 3, lambda = 1 - eps (reduces to E_s at eps = 0); default prestrain_stiffening = false because the stage-resolved E_s already encodes in-vivo stiffness.
tubular_foundation_model.foundation_stiffness: K_tube = |sigma_rr(R_in)| / u0; K_slab = M_s / H_s (R -> infinity); curvature_factor = K_tube / K_slab; K_eff = (E_s / H_s) * curvature_factor * prestrain_factor.

verification.lame_closed_form: u(r) = A r + B / r, sigma_rr = 2 (lambda_L + mu) A - 2 mu B / r^2, with u(R_in) = 1, u(R_out) = 0

prefactor_calibration.method: OLS through origin of lambda_obs on 2 pi ell_tube over the 5 buckled Chick stages (E8-E16)

tubular_foundation_model.mode_quantisation: n = round(2 pi R_lumen / lambda_tube); lambda_quantized = 2 pi R_lumen / n (integer number of ridges on the tube circumference).

shh_bmp_cluster_model.shh_field: Shh(x,y) = G_sigma * [ max(-lap w, 0) * (1 + zeta * lambda * |kappa_c|) ], sigma = 0.16 lambda, zeta = 1.0; kappa_c = div(grad w / |grad w|) is the crest-contour turning curvature standing in for the 3D dome curvature of zigzag elbows that the developable height field w = f(q0 x + phi(y)) cannot represent.
shh_bmp_cluster_model.cluster_indicator: C = soft threshold of Shh above its 0.82 quantile (top 18 % of the field); BMP = C.
shh_bmp_cluster_model.mechanical_feedback: alpha_3(x,y) = alpha_3 + 0.60 * C(x,y); the gain pushes a zigzag-stage elbow (alpha_3 = 0.20-0.32) above the villus threshold alpha_3 = 0.65 inside a cluster; the FvK surface responds via a trust-region-limited (30 % of rms) linear Newton step of the FvK operator.

clusters_per_villus.source: Walton et al. 2012 PNAS; Walton et al. 2016 Development

elbow_localization_index_null.note: uniform distribution; papers require > 1 but report no quantitative enrichment ratio

cluster_fraction_on_tips_expected.source: Shyer et al. 2015 Cell (Ptch1/Shh response concentrated at tips)
